name: MARN 5052
title: Paleooceanography
description: Exploration of how the geologic record, geochemical proxies and model simulations can be used to understand climate change at centennial and longer timescales, with an emphasis on oceanographic processes. Topics include global overturning circulation, carbon cycle dynamics, and feedback mechanisms that govern long-term climate variability.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to students who have passed MARN 4052.
